registry: Common Command Registry for Uncrewed Systems (UAV, UGV, USV, UUV)

Position.label: Position
Position.description: WGS 84 position with an optional vertical component.

VerticalTarget.label: Vertical target
VerticalTarget.description: A vertical value and the reference it is measured from.

vehicleCommands.title: Go to position
vehicleCommands.description: Move to a position, then stop or continue to the next instruction.

fields.name: speed
fields.label: speed
fields.description: Desired speed. Reference given by the platform default (ground speed for UGV, water-relative for USV/UUV, air or ground speed for UAV).

fields.name: acceptanceRadius
fields.label: acceptanceRadius
fields.description: Distance from the target at which the target counts as reached.

fields.name: holdTime
fields.label: holdTime
fields.description: Time to remain at the position after arrival before completing.

fields.name: passThrough
fields.label: passThrough
fields.description: If true the vehicle does not stop at the position and may pass within `acceptanceRadius`. (default: false)

vehicleCommands.notes: For Routes waypoints, `location` is a context parameter filled from the waypoint geometry.

vehicleCommands.title: Follow path
vehicleCommands.description: Follow an ordered list of positions.

fields.name: path
fields.label: path
fields.description: Ordered positions to visit (at least two).

fields.name: speed
fields.label: speed
fields.description: Desired speed. Reference given by the platform default (ground speed for UGV, water-relative for USV/UUV, air or ground speed for UAV).

fields.name: acceptanceRadius
fields.label: acceptanceRadius
fields.description: Distance from the target at which the target counts as reached.

fields.name: interpolation
fields.label: interpolation
fields.description: How to interpolate between positions. (default: linear)

fields.name: closed
fields.label: closed
fields.description: If true, return to the first position at the end. (default: false)

vehicleCommands.notes: For Routes segments, `path` is a context parameter filled from the segment geometry.

vehicleCommands.title: Hold position
vehicleCommands.description: Hold position: hover (UAV), stand still (UGV), station-keep (USV, UUV).

fields.name: duration
fields.label: duration
fields.description: Time to hold. If absent, hold until another command replaces this one.

fields.name: location
fields.label: location
fields.description: Position to hold. If absent, the current position.

fields.name: holdMode
fields.label: holdMode
fields.description: Holding pattern. `circle` is for platforms that cannot hover. (default: station-keep)

fields.name: radius
fields.label: radius
fields.description: Circle radius when `holdMode` is `circle`. Sign: positive clockwise, negative counter-clockwise.

vehicleCommands.title: Orbit a point
vehicleCommands.description: Circle around a center point.

fields.name: turns
fields.label: turns
fields.description: Number of turns. If both `turns` and `duration` are absent, orbit until replaced.

fields.name: speed
fields.label: speed
fields.description: Desired speed. Reference given by the platform default (ground speed for UGV, water-relative for USV/UUV, air or ground speed for UAV).

vehicleCommands.title: Set heading
vehicleCommands.description: Rotate to a heading (yaw in place, or turn on the spot for a ground vehicle).

fields.name: lock
fields.label: lock
fields.description: If true, keep this heading during later navigation until changed (persistence becomes `latched`). (default: false)

vehicleCommands.title: Move relative to current position
vehicleCommands.description: Move a given distance along a bearing (drive forward, back up, sidestep, climb).

fields.name: verticalDistance
fields.label: verticalDistance
fields.description: Vertical change, positive up. Ignored by ground and surface vehicles.

fields.name: speed
fields.label: speed
fields.description: Desired speed. Reference given by the platform default (ground speed for UGV, water-relative for USV/UUV, air or ground speed for UAV).

vehicleCommands.title: Return to home
vehicleCommands.description: Return to a recovery point and perform a final action.

fields.name: destination
fields.label: destination
fields.description: Which recovery point to use. (default: home)

fields.name: finalAction
fields.label: finalAction
fields.description: What to do on arrival. (default: default)

fields.name: vertical
fields.label: vertical
fields.description: Height, altitude or depth to use for the return leg.

vehicleCommands.title: Stop
vehicleCommands.description: Stop movement and hold the current position.

fields.name: mode
fields.label: mode
fields.description: `controlled` decelerates within platform limits, `immediate` stops as fast as safely possible. (default: controlled)

vehicleCommands.title: Set vertical position
vehicleCommands.description: Change altitude, height or depth, keeping the horizontal position.
vehicleCommands.notes: Later `vehicle.goto` commands without a vertical value use this setting.

vehicleCommands.title: Take off
vehicleCommands.description: Take off and climb to a height.

fields.name: location
fields.label: location
fields.description: Position to take off from and then hold. If absent, the current position.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: heading
fields.description: Heading during and after the climb.

vehicleCommands.title: Land
vehicleCommands.description: Descend and land.

fields.name: location
fields.label: location
fields.description: Landing position. If absent, the current position.

fields.name: disarmAfter
fields.label: disarmAfter
fields.description: If true, disarm after touchdown. (default: true)

vehicleCommands.title: Transition flight mode
vehicleCommands.description: Transition a hybrid aircraft between hover and forward flight.

vehicleCommands.title: Surface
vehicleCommands.description: Ascend to the water surface (submerged vehicles).

fields.name: holdTime
fields.label: holdTime
fields.description: Time to stay at the surface (for example to acquire a position fix or communicate).

fields.name: waitForFix
fields.label: waitForFix
fields.description: If true, stay at the surface until a position fix is obtained or `holdTime` expires. (default: false)

vehicleCommands.title: Dock or undock
vehicleCommands.description: Dock with, or leave, a docking or charging station.

fields.name: station
fields.label: station
fields.description: Identifier of the station (URI or local id). If absent, the nearest known station.

fields.name: location
fields.label: location
fields.description: Approach position, if the station does not define one.

vehicleCommands.title: Set speed
vehicleCommands.description: Set the speed used by later movement commands.

fields.name: speedType
fields.label: speedType
fields.description: What the speed is relative to. (default: ground)

vehicleCommands.title: Set operating mode
vehicleCommands.description: Change the operating mode.

fields.name: platformMode
fields.label: platformMode
fields.description: Platform-specific mode name, used when `mode` does not identify it.

vehicleCommands.title: Arm or disarm
vehicleCommands.description: Enable or disable actuators (motors, thrusters, drive).

fields.name: armed
fields.label: armed
fields.description: True to arm, false to disarm.

fields.name: force
fields.label: force
fields.description: Bypass safety checks. A command with `force=true` SHALL be treated as `destructive`. (default: false)

vehicleCommands.title: Set home position
vehicleCommands.description: Set the home (recovery) position.

fields.name: location
fields.label: location
fields.description: New home position. If absent, the current position.

vehicleCommands.title: Restart
vehicleCommands.description: Restart or shut down a vehicle subsystem.

fields.name: shutdown
fields.label: shutdown
fields.description: If true, shut down instead of restarting. (default: false)

vehicleCommands.title: Start mission
vehicleCommands.description: Start executing an uploaded or queued mission.

fields.name: firstItem
fields.label: firstItem
fields.description: Index of the first item to execute.

fields.name: lastItem
fields.label: lastItem
fields.description: Index of the last item to execute.

vehicleCommands.title: Pause mission
vehicleCommands.description: Pause mission execution.

fields.name: behavior
fields.label: behavior
fields.description: What to do while paused. (default: hold-position)

vehicleCommands.title: Resume mission
vehicleCommands.description: Resume a paused mission.

vehicleCommands.title: Abort mission
vehicleCommands.description: Abandon the mission and perform a fallback action.

vehicleCommands.title: Wait
vehicleCommands.description: Wait for a duration or until a time.

fields.name: until
fields.label: until
fields.description: Absolute time to wait until. Exactly one of `duration` and `until` is required.

vehicleCommands.title: Emergency stop
vehicleCommands.description: Stop actuators as fast as possible. May cause an uncontrolled descent or drift.

vehicleCommands.title: Terminate
vehicleCommands.description: End operation irreversibly (flight termination, scuttling, deploying a recovery device).

sensorCommands.title: Set power state
sensorCommands.description: Power a sensor on, off, or to standby.
sensorCommands.notes: A deployment SHALL classify this command `flight-critical` for sensors the vehicle depends on for navigation.

sensorCommands.title: Start acquisition
sensorCommands.description: Start producing observations.

fields.name: sampleCount
fields.label: sampleCount
fields.description: Stop automatically after this many samples.

sensorCommands.title: Stop acquisition
sensorCommands.description: Stop producing observations.

sensorCommands.title: Trigger a measurement
sensorCommands.description: Take one measurement or a short series (image, ping, spectrum).
sensorCommands.notes: Result: Links to the produced Observation(s).

sensorCommands.title: Set sampling rate
sensorCommands.description: Set the rate at which observations are produced.

sensorCommands.title: Apply configuration
sensorCommands.description: Apply a named, previously stored configuration.

sensorCommands.title: Calibrate
sensorCommands.description: Run a calibration.
sensorCommands.notes: A deployment SHALL classify this command `flight-critical` for vehicle-state sensors (inertial, heading, depth, GNSS).

sensorCommands.title: Self-test
sensorCommands.description: Run a built-in self-test.

sensorCommands.title: Reset
sensorCommands.description: Reset the sensor.

sensorCommands.title: Get status
sensorCommands.description: Return the state and health of the sensor.

sensorCommands.title: Start recording
sensorCommands.description: Start recording data to onboard storage.

sensorCommands.title: Stop recording
sensorCommands.description: Stop recording.

sensorCommands.title: Mark event
sensorCommands.description: Insert a labeled marker into the recorded data.

sensorCommands.title: Capture image
sensorCommands.description: Capture still images.

fields.name: count
fields.label: count
fields.description: Number of images. 0 means continue until `camera.stop-image-capture`. (default: 1)

sensorCommands.notes: Result: Links to the produced image Observation(s).

sensorCommands.title: Stop image capture
sensorCommands.description: Stop an ongoing image sequence.

sensorCommands.title: Start video
sensorCommands.description: Start video recording.
sensorCommands.notes: Result: Link to the video DataStream or Observation.

sensorCommands.title: Stop video
sensorCommands.description: Stop video recording.

sensorCommands.title: Set camera mode
sensorCommands.description: Switch between still and video operation.

sensorCommands.title: Configure image
sensorCommands.description: Set image size, format and quality.

sensorCommands.title: Set exposure
sensorCommands.description: Set exposure control.

sensorCommands.title: Set zoom
sensorCommands.description: Set zoom. Exactly one of the three parameters is required.

fields.name: rate
fields.label: rate
fields.description: Continuous zoom rate, from -1 (out, fastest) to 1 (in, fastest). 0 stops.

sensorCommands.title: Set focus
sensorCommands.description: Set focus.

sensorCommands.title: Select image source
sensorCommands.description: Select which imaging sensor of a multi-sensor camera is used.

sensorCommands.title: Set trigger distance
sensorCommands.description: Capture an image every given distance traveled (survey mode). A value of 0 disables it.

fields.name: triggerNow
fields.label: triggerNow
fields.description: Capture an image immediately as well. (default: false)

sensorCommands.notes: Persistent. On a segment, the mapping issues a `distance = 0` revert at the segment end.

sensorCommands.title: Point gimbal
sensorCommands.description: Point a gimbal or pan-tilt unit by angle or rate. At least one angle or one rate is required.

sensorCommands.title: Point at location
sensorCommands.description: Keep a sensor pointed at a geographic location (region of interest).

sensorCommands.title: Clear pointing target
sensorCommands.description: Release the region of interest and return to the neutral or previous pointing.

sensorCommands.title: Set gimbal mode
sensorCommands.description: Set the stabilization mode.

sensorCommands.title: Track image point
sensorCommands.description: Track a point in the image. Stopped by `gimbal.clear-target`.

fields.name: x
fields.label: x
fields.description: Horizontal position in the image, from 0 (left) to 1 (right).

fields.name: y
fields.label: y
fields.description: Vertical position in the image, from 0 (top) to 1 (bottom).

sensorCommands.title: Set range
sensorCommands.description: Set the range scale of a lidar, radar or sonar.

sensorCommands.title: Set gain
sensorCommands.description: Set receiver gain.

sensorCommands.title: Set operating frequency
sensorCommands.description: Select the operating frequency of a radar or sonar.

sensorCommands.title: Set scan sector
sensorCommands.description: Limit scanning to a sector.

fields.name: startAngle
fields.label: startAngle
fields.description: Sector start, relative to the vehicle heading.

fields.name: endAngle
fields.label: endAngle
fields.description: Sector end, relative to the vehicle heading.

sensorCommands.title: Enable or disable transmission
sensorCommands.description: Switch an active sensor between transmitting and silent.

sensorCommands.title: Collect sample
sensorCommands.description: Collect a physical sample (water, soil, air, sediment).

fields.name: location
fields.label: location
fields.description: Location to collect at. If absent, the current position.

sensorCommands.title: Operate gripper
sensorCommands.description: Open or close a gripper.

sensorCommands.title: Release payload
sensorCommands.description: Drop or deploy an item.

fields.name: location
fields.label: location
fields.description: Release position. If absent, the current position.

sensorCommands.title: Operate winch
sensorCommands.description: Deploy, retract or hold a winch.

fields.name: length
fields.label: length
fields.description: Cable length to pay out or retract.

sensorCommands.title: Set lights
sensorCommands.description: Control lights or illuminators.

sensorCommands.title: Set switch
sensorCommands.description: Switch a discrete output (relay).

sensorCommands.title: Set actuator output
sensorCommands.description: Set a continuous output (servo, motor).
